{{legend0|#c21b18|80–90%}} }} {{ElectionsNE}} The '''2002 Nebraska gubernatorial election''', held on November 5, 2002, featured [[incumbent]] Republican [[Governor of Nebraska]] [[Mike Johanns]] defeating his Democratic opponent Stormy Dean in a landslide. This was the first [[gubernatorial]] election in [[Nebraska]] where the winning primary candidates chose their running mates after the primary election. Prior to this, both the governor and the lieutenant governor were chosen at the primary election.{{cite web|url=http://www.governor.nebraska.gov/responsibilities/pdf/State_Executive%20Branch.pdf|work=Nebraska State Government|title=State Executive Branch|page=424|publisher=Nebraska Office of the Governor|format=PDF|access-date=9 April 2011|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110919201921/http://www.governor.nebraska.gov/responsibilities/pdf/State_Executive%20Branch.pdf|archive-date=19 September 2011}} This was also the first Nebraska gubernatorial election in which a Republican was re-elected since [[1956 Nebraska gubernatorial election|1956]].{{cite web|url=http://www2.scholastic.com/browse/article.jsp?id=5416|title=The President's New Cabinet|date=January 2005|publisher=Scholastic News|access-date=9 April 2011|archive-date=9 June 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120609103723/http://www.scholastic.com/browse/article.jsp?id=5416|url-status=dead}} ==Republican Party primary== ===Candidates=== *[[Mike Johanns]], incumbent [[Governor of Nebraska]] *Robert J.
